assertions.value: explained by|Enablement by Netresearch|Netresearch Guide to
assertions.description: Uses an endorsement line from the Sharing knowledge group
Does not use the line reserved for Netresearch product brands

B2B price lists

OroCommerce explained by Netresearch

Netresearch DTT GmbH

Netresearch DTT GmbH
